Took the first session (along with Younes B. ) in the first ever Hugging Face hackathon in the GCC region.

The room was filled with curious people. A big shout out to Qai for partnering with us and also taking care of all the logistics of the hackathon. It was more than we could have asked for.

For those of you who are participating in the hackathon tomorrow you will find Sayak Paul and Niels Rogge give a session on image generation and local ai respectively.

Special thanks to Serge Habis for making this event a reality.
